notes.title: Development Update - September 2nd 2025
notes.content:
I hope all of you have been enjoying the latest update to Stellar Navigator, and I want to thank everyone who submitted feedback and reported issues during the public beta of v0.4.3. It really made the release process go much smoother, and I look forward to future open beta tests of up coming versions. Your support and contributions mean a lot and make a big difference! So keep an eye out for the next open beta branch.


Major Update One
With the minor update out of the way bringing with it a few new features and bug fixes, work has since been started on the first Major Update of Stellar Navigator. This one will come with more planet types, user feedback, and of course the ability to create multiple galaxies. This will lay the ground work for the next major update which will include Steam Workshop support. Remember to follow along with the public road map to see any mid-month status changes to features.



Much the same as was done in the latest version, there will be another conversion script to bring your galaxy into the new multi-galaxy model. As such, this will be another "breaking change" to Stellar Navigator. What this means is once your galaxy file has been converted, older versions of the application will not be able to use them. However, when this update is published, it will open up the scale and freedom of Stellar Navigator as well as bring with it the initial tools for collaborating with your friends!



In later versions there will be further work done to bring the various galaxies you create into a much more exciting format, but for now you can expect the ability to create and load galaxies through a new galaxy selector which will appear on the main menu.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322332/15d33780571836cea8dc39848dd40f5fd17b4dae.png"]

To give a little more insight into what is being planned for this update and the galaxy selection menu. These are some of the ideas being experimented with to not only allow for the ability for you to create multiple galaxies, but also to give you the tools to define them with your creativity:

Galaxy image selection, use the default galaxy image or add your own.

Galaxy information, write about what makes this galaxy unique.

Galaxy type, is it a spiral, Elliptical, Barred, or Irregular?

Please remember: this is a work in progress and ideas shared may or may not make it into the final update. As always, the focus will be on adding the core functionality to bring you these exciting new updates faster.



That's it for today - keep an eye out for updates on the official Stellar Navigator Discord server. And as always, keep looking to the stars!

notes.title: Stellar Navigator v0.4.3
notes.content:
Stellar Navigator v0.4.3

Annotations for star systems
This allows for custom annotations that can be placed anywhere in the star system (“Solar Navigator”) view. Entirely revamped marker (“Pin”) system which should be far easier to use and includes additional features. 

Custom pins – You can create your own pin images and place them in the data files for Stellar Navigator to use in your star systems.,

Favoriting pins for quick access.,

Adding text beneath pins to give them more life.,

A conversion script to bring all your existing markers in your solar systems over to the new pin system. Ideally this will provide a seamless method to update your existing work into the new system; however, this is not always a guarantee such are data conversions.,
 User Feedback!
Clouds can now be toggled on and off.,

Additional data points for orbital period.,

Ability to turn the scanner visual on and off in the galaxy map.,

Added a new setting to the games graphics settings to select which monitor Stellar Navigator should use. This is a potential fix for when some users with multi-monitor set ups are unable to select a resolution. This issue is still under investigation.

notes.title: Development Update - August 4th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


A lot of effort this month of course went into preparing the first minor release for all of you to try out in the public beta branch. If you haven’t jumped into the public beta branch to try out the new feature, here is what is included:


Annotations for star systems.

This allows for custom annotations that can be placed anywhere in the star system (“Solar Navigator”) view.

Entirely revamped marker (“Pin”) system which should be far easier to use and includes additional features.

Custom pins – You can create your own pin images and place them in the data files for Stellar Navigator to use in your star systems.

Favoriting pins for quick access.

Adding text beneath pins to give them more life.

A conversion script to bring all your existing markers in your solar systems over to the new pin system. Ideally this will provide a seamless method to update your existing work into the new system; however, this is not always a guarantee such are data conversions.

User Feedback!

Clouds can now be toggled on and off.

Additional data points for orbital period.

Ability to turn the scanner visual on and off in the galaxy map.

Added a new setting to the games graphics settings to select which monitor Stellar Navigator should use. This is a potential fix for when some users with multi-monitor set ups are unable to select a resolution. This issue is still under investigation.

⚠️The minor patch will be released to the live branch on August 29th, 2025. As this is early access, and there’s always a chance for things to go sideways, please back up your game’s data folder in .../My Games/Stellar Navigator… before the 29th. ⚠️

 

As for this month’s updates: New planet type designs have moved on prototyping and in some cases implementation! For Major Update One you can expect at least two new planet types based off the fantastic ideas provided by our very own Planetologists!



And as fun as reading can be, let’s look at some visuals:

Prototyping procedural clouds, and the new lighting effects


[previewyoutube="IagQydKjs-0;full"][/previewyoutube]
Finally, I am looking through the ideas submitted to the ideas board by the community to see which bits of feedback and ideas could be included in the major update. More on this as the scope of the major update settles down and work begins on the multiple galaxies.

 

Well folks, that’s all for this month! I hope you are all having a wonderful summer and as always keep looking to the stars!

notes.title: Minor Update One in Public Beta
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A bit of an early and extra update on development this month because I wanted to share a few things that are going on!

Minor update one available through opting in
Development work has been concluded on the first minor update to Stellar Navigator. However, before it goes live on the Public branch it will be running in the Public Beta Branch ("publicbeta"). How this branch differs from branch that requires sign up is that anyone can get access to it by going into their Steam settings and opting into the beta. Moreover, this branch will include more stable release candidates for the live application. Ideally, it will be a much better experience, but this ensures that everyone has the chance to test it out if they wish and provide their feedback and raise any bugs. Think of it as a larger test group where you get to try all the new shiny things.


⚠️ As always, if you do choose to opt into any betas please back up your data folder found in .../My Documents/My Games/ Stellar Navigator.⚠️


Road Map updates
https://trello.com/b/YTYDvtwl/stellar-navigator-road-map
\

All features in Minor Update One have been moved to the Committed status.

Additional Planet Types for Major Update One are in design.



Regular Development Update
There will be a regular development update at the beginning of next month to show of some of the work that has started going on for the next Major Update. So stay tuned.

That's all for today, have a great week everyone!

notes.title: Development Update - June 2nd 2025
notes.content:
Hello Navigators!

This month has been a busy one getting ready for Game Con Canada. Nevertheless, work has continued for the first minor release for Stellar Navigator. I’m excited to get this one out to everyone as the new marker system is really shaping up and quite enjoyable to use, and of course the quality-of-life improvement, orbital period and cloud toggle are to come!

Beta Branch

Despite the very real possibility of issues cropping up in Stellar Navigator as it makes its way to full release, I am keen to do everything feasible to ensure that the galaxies that all of you create throughout Early Access will stay with you right up to the full launch and beyond. 

However, and as always, it is important for each of you to back up your data prior to any update to Stellar Navigator. 

This can be done by finding the Stellar Navigator folder in My Documents/My Games and making a backup copy of it.

So, what about this Beta Branch?

Well, to ensure as smooth a release as possible with each new version of Stellar Navigator coming out in Early Access, I want to get as much feedback as possible from both my internal testers, but also the community. That said, I will be introducing a new Stellar Navigator stream using Steam’s Betas. What this means for all of you Navigators is that you, at your discretion, may pull the absolute latest available version of Stellar Navigator before it’s released officially on the store and play around with it.
Due to the potential instability of the development build, access to it will come with a few expectations:
[olist]
 You only access the development build after you have copied the data folder out of My Games/Stellar Navigator.
 You understand that it is possible to lose or corrupt data using these development builds, and there is nothing the developer can do to retrieve this data.
 Whenever possible, you provide feedback and issues discovered while working with the development branch.
[/olist]

Other than that, I hope many of you decide to experience the latest updates to Stellar Navigator and join in the exploration and development of this wonderful application!

How do I get access to the beta development build?

You may sign up for access to the beta through this link: https://www.stellar-navigator.com/beta-sign-up
All that will be asked for is your Discord username as it appears in the Stellar Navigator Discord server.

Well, that’s it for this month! In next month’s update I hope to share some highlights from Game Con Canada and show off more exciting things happening in the development of Stellar Navigator. 

Until then, keep looking to the stars 💫

notes.title: Development Update - May 1st 2025
notes.content:
New marker system in development

The existing marker system was created very early on in the development of Stellar Navigator, and as such is showing its age compared to the more recent features that were developed later in the project's life cycle. That being the case, it was one of the first features I wanted to rework post launch of early access. Let's take a closer look at its progress:

Fluid interaction
It was very important for this system to be easy and quick to use. Marking up the system shouldn't be a difficult task after you have already spent a long time setting up each planet. Therefore, rather than it starting with a window, it starts with a new right click menu that is accessible at any time while in solar navigator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322332/3435ef88b0d2069d32854823b8b25e41ad815791.gif


Introducing Annotations
In addition to the easier access to markers and favorited markers, there will be Annotations. These are a different kind of marker that allow free form text to be placed in areas around a solar system. This way not only can markers be placed, but also information about key areas of a solar system. Below is a mockup of what a label may look like in Stellar Navigator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322332/f9675c92116ef9bcc8f7f5dcefae134935fd583c.png

Community submitted ideas
It has and will continue to be my desire to ensure that the community has the ability to provide input into the early access development of Stellar Navigator. I want to ensure that I capture as many of the tools I can to allow user's creativity to be... out of this world!

That said, for the next minor update to Stellar Navigator the following three ideas will be included:
[olist]
An option to turn planet clouds on and off.
Celestial body data point - Orbital Period.
Edit planet radius and orbital radius by entering numeric values.
[/olist]

🎉Planetologist Winners!!🎉
Last month there was a community event held on our Discord server (https://discord.gg/vcPTMpavep) where Navigators submitted a description of their ideal planet to be voted on by the community. Thank you to everyone who submitted a planet and voted. In the end the votes were very close at the top three, so close that two individuals will be working with me to realize their very own ideal planet!

First place winners!
StregaRevenge & Thunderbat

Second place winner!
Gameonic

Congratulations to these winners who's names will be included in Stellar Navigator as Navigator Planetologists. Stay tuned for updates on these new planet types!


Remember to also check out the public road map here: https://trello.com/b/YTYDvtwl/stellar-navigator-road-map which has seen some changes with the marker system being pushed into development and the above community ideas included as a deliverable of minor update one.

That's all for this month. Until next time, Keep looking to the stars!
